Welcome to the Hub

A grill, a bar & nine rooms

BBQ HUB Ella is a charcoal grill, bar and lounge with nine modern rooms upstairs — hidden on a quiet interior road, about 400 m from Ella’s main street of restaurants, cafés and bars.

Sri Lankan and continental cooking, vegetarian dishes on request, and a breakfast guests rave about — continental, Sri Lankan or “whatever you want”.
